query: 员工申诉机制 员工申诉机制 衡量企业为员工提供的正式申诉渠道的可达性、运作独立性及问题闭环处理能力。重点考察匿名保护、反报复政策、明确的处理时限及高级别的申议/升级机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备独立的匿名申诉渠道（如第三方平台）；有明确的书面“反报复”政策保护申诉人；规定了清晰的处理时限（如 48 小时反馈）及未决事项向上升级（Escalation）至董事会的路径。 • 1分（合格）：建立了内部申诉渠道（如意见箱、HR 邮箱），具备基础的申诉受理流程和保护声明，但缺乏第三方独立性、明确的处理时限或高级别的管理层监督机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式申诉渠道披露，或仅有笼统的“欢迎员工提意见”等非制度化表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的员工（含全职、劳务派遣及主要现场供应商员工），且定期进行员工知晓度培训/测评。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅总部可见而基层厂区难以触达，或未说明知晓度/可用性的覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 员工申诉机制 员工诉说渠道 举报热线 反报复 升级机制 匿名举报 申诉处理时限 结案率 employee grievance mechanism speak-up channel whistleblowing hotline anti-retaliation escalation anonymous reporting grievance handling timeframe 员工正式申诉渠道有哪些（热线、第三方平台、HR邮箱等）？ 是否支持匿名及书面反报复保护？ 是否规定处理时限与升级至高层/董事会路径？ 机制覆盖哪些员工类型？ 是否开展知晓度培训或测评？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '员工申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 员工正式申诉渠道有哪些（热线、第三方平台、HR邮箱等）？ 是否支持匿名及书面反报复保护？ 是否规定处理时限与升级至高层/董事会路径？ 机制覆盖哪些员工类型？ 是否开展知晓度培训或测评？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“欢迎提意见”；仅有客户投诉热线；仅有供应商申诉机制；仅有反歧视政策而无通用申诉渠道；区分：员工申诉机制面向员工可达性与闭环；供应商申诉面向供应商；举报人保护更偏舞弊/合规举报保护；纠正补救是违规后处置流程，不是申诉入口本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Material Issues / Excellent Services and Products
results.text: The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. Employees from Hong Kong and Mainland China can refer to 'Employee Handbook' of the Hong Kong office and the 'Employee Relations management Methods' of the Mainland China offices respectively as all relevant requirements in different regions are listed in them. In addition, the Group has implemented firewalls, behavioural analysis tools, anti-virus software, and encrypted all files to enhance network security and protect customer data. The Group reviews its cybersecurity regularly and has formulated a contingency plan that sets out procedures and guidelines for responding to and handling cybersecurity incidents such as cyberattacks that may threaten its business.

results.text: The Group also organizes training camps from time to time on different topics to meet the needs of employees at different levels, including 'Sons of the Sea Cornerstone Camp', 'Haina Inclusion Camp', 'Employee with Potential Training Camp', 'Sales Manager Studying Camp' and 'Senior Management Power Camp'. In addition, the Group established a LAMPS system, in which employees can choose to develop themselves in-depth in different parts of the company such as management (LM), professional (P), sales (S), and administration (A). They can also choose to change their professions and develop themselves in breadth. The LAMPS system interrelates with various aspects that run through the human resources value chain such as personnel management, qualification standards, appointment procedures, business performance evaluation, opt-out mechanisms, and remuneration packages and fringe benefits. At the same time, the Group has established a human resources shared service centre to provide induction training and guidance for new employees to help them understand the company culture and integrate into the team quickly.
